name: deviation-investigation-sop
title: Deviation SOP Validator
summary: Review one synthetic deviation investigation against a versioned SOP checklist.
description: Validate one synthetic deviation-investigation record from either a canonical JSON export or an attached Word report plus SOP checklist. The review checks administrative evidence presence and timing, writes JSON and Markdown outputs, and remains review-only. Document mode requires confirmation of an exact fingerprinted extraction before deterministic validation. No quality-system connection, approval, closure, task creation, scientific assessment, or regulatory determination is included.
